title: Classic Physique Hypertrophy
desc:
** HIGHLY RECOMMEND A DELOAD WEEK AT WEEK 6 (50% of SETS + 70% weight ON WORKING SETS) **

      This was built around my deficiencies but it is very well rounded. Made for taller guys with longer leverages who struggle with chest and lat activation with long limbs. This is a bodybuilding program not tailored to power building. Unleash your potential with the Classic Physique Hypertrophy program, a comprehensive 12-week journey designed to sculpt and define your physique. With 72 training sessions packed into this plan, you'll engage in a variety of targeted exercises, including the Incline Bench Press and Pec Deck, focusing on building muscle mass and strength across all major muscle groups. Each workout is strategically structured to maximize hypertrophy, ensuring you push your limits while maintaining proper form. Get ready to transform your body and achieve the classic look you've always wanted!
